title: AutoCedar: An Agentic Framework for Verifier-Guided Access Control Policy Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2607.03656v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Language Models are increasingly used to turn natural-language requirements into code. In access control, that shortcut is dangerous: a generated policy can compile and read correctly while granting access that no one approved. The difficulty is not only writing policy code. It is fixing what the requirements mean before code is written, and then checking that the final policy actually satisfies that intent. We present AutoCedar, a verifier-guided system that first turns natural-language access-control requirements into a reviewed, checkable target, and then synthesizes Cedar policies against that target. AutoCedar decomposes schema and policy authoring into small intent atoms: reviewable claims about vocabulary and behavior. translated_title: AutoCedar：一个验证器引导的访问控制策略合成智能体框架
translated_abstract: 大语言模型正越来越多地被用于将自然语言需求转化为代码。在访问控制领域，这种捷径是危险的：一个生成的策略可能编译通过且看起来正确，却授予了未经任何人批准的访问权限。难点不仅在于编写策略代码，还在于在编写代码之前明确需求的确切含义，然后再检查最终策略是否真正满足该意图。我们提出了 AutoCedar，一个由验证器引导的系统，它首先将自然语言访问控制需求转化为经过审查、可检验的目标，然后针对该目标合成 Cedar 策略。AutoCedar 将模式（schema）和策略的编写分解为小的意图原子：即关于词汇和行为的可审查声明。一旦这些原子通过机械验证和人工意图审查，模型便会提出候选策略，验证器会对照已批准的目标对其进行检查，并将每一次失败转化为修复信息。
tldr: AutoCedar 提出了一种验证器引导的智能体框架，通过将访问控制需求分解为可审查、可机械验证的“意图原子”，并利用验证器对照经人工审查的目标迭代修复策略，确保从自然语言合成的 Cedar 访问控制策略真正符合用户意图。
en_tdlr: AutoCedar is a verifier-guided agentic framework that decomposes access-control requirements into reviewable intent atoms and iteratively synthesizes and repairs Cedar policies against a human-approved, mechanically checkable target, ensuring generated policies truly match the stated intent.
